newsitem.title: BELGIUM: EU expansion east to swell dairy surplus - Fischler.
newsitem.headline: EU expansion east to swell dairy surplus - Fischler.

text.p: The European Union's dairy surplus could jump by two million tonnes if 10 central and east European countries (CEECs) join the bloc in 2002, EU Farm Commissioner Franz Fischler said on Thursday.
The forecast assumed that EU milk production quotas and high price support would remain in place and would apply to new members, Fischler told an annual meeting of the European Dairy Association .
"There is a serious risk that this policy would not suit the current situation in these countries," Fischler said.
"We have to avoid creating incentives in these countries to produce more and...to consume less, as would happen with rising domestic agricultural prices."
The EU-15 surplus, which has to be exported or stored, is seen staying virtually unchanged at the 1996 level of 9.5 million tonnes.
